policies.title: S3 bucket uses a public ACL
policies.description: Checks that no bucket ACL is public or authenticated-read.
policies.rationale: Public buckets are a leading cause of data exposure.

hints: line-level parsing only: no variables, modules or expressions are evaluated

policies.remediation: Use private ACLs and explicit policies.

policies.title: S3 public access block is switched off
policies.description: Checks that no public-access-block setting is false.
policies.rationale: These switches are the account-level safety net against accidental exposure.

hints: line-level parsing only: no variables, modules or expressions are evaluated

policies.title: Security group opens SSH or RDP to the world
policies.description: Checks that no ingress rule exposes port 22 or 3389 to 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0.
policies.rationale: Administrative ports open to the internet are scanned and brute forced constantly.

hints: line-level parsing only: no variables, modules or expressions are evaluated

policies.absence_note: No ingress rules. (An egress rule to these ports can be a false fail: the line-level parser cannot always tell.)
policies.remediation: Restrict the source to a VPN or bastion range.

policies.title: Security group opens every port to the world
policies.description: Checks that no ingress rule allows all ports from the world.
policies.rationale: It removes the network layer as a defence.

hints: line-level parsing only: no variables, modules or expressions are evaluated

policies.positive:
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "r" {
  type = "ingress"
  from_port = 0
  to_port = 0
  protocol = "-1"
  cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
}
policies.negative:
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "r" {
  type = "ingress"
  from_port = 443
  to_port = 443
  protocol = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
}

policies.title: Azure NSG rule allows any port from anywhere
policies.description: Checks that no inbound allow rule uses a wildcard port and a wildcard source.

hints: line-level parsing only: no variables, modules or expressions are evaluated

policies.remediation: Restrict the port range and source.

policies.title: GCP firewall allows traffic from the whole internet
policies.description: Checks that firewall source_ranges does not include 0.0.0.0/0 (ports are not examined at this level).
policies.rationale: Open sources should be a conscious choice for public services only.

hints: line-level parsing only: no variables, modules or expressions are evaluated

policies.title: Cloud Storage grants access to all users
policies.description: Checks that bucket IAM does not use allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers.
policies.rationale: These principals mean the entire internet or any Google account.

hints: line-level parsing only: no variables, modules or expressions are evaluated

policies.title: Azure storage account allows public blob access
policies.description: Checks that public blob access is not enabled.
policies.rationale: Public containers expose data to anyone.

hints: line-level parsing only: no variables, modules or expressions are evaluated

policies.absence_note: Not set; the provider/platform default applies (UNVERIFIED), so not flagged.

policies.title: Azure storage account allows insecure transport
policies.description: Checks that HTTPS-only is not disabled and TLS 1.0 is not the minimum.
policies.rationale: Plain HTTP or TLS 1.0 can be intercepted or downgraded.

hints: line-level parsing only: no variables, modules or expressions are evaluated

policies.absence_note: Not set; platform default applies (UNVERIFIED), so not flagged.
policies.remediation: Enable HTTPS-only and set min_tls_version to TLS1_2.

policies.title: RDS instance storage is not encrypted
policies.rationale: Unencrypted storage exposes data in snapshots and on lost media.

hints: line-level parsing only: no variables, modules or expressions are evaluated

policies.absence_note: Default is false: treated as a failure.

policies.title: RDS instance is publicly accessible
policies.description: Checks that publicly_accessible is not true.
policies.rationale: Databases should be reachable only from application networks.

hints: line-level parsing only: no variables, modules or expressions are evaluated

policies.title: A credential is written literally in the configuration
policies.description: Checks that access keys, passwords and tokens are not quoted string literals.
policies.rationale: Literals end up in version control and state files.

hints: line-level parsing only: no variables, modules or expressions are evaluated

policies.remediation: Reference a variable, a secrets manager or the provider's environment.

policies.title: Load balancer listener uses plain HTTP
policies.description: Checks that listeners use HTTPS/TLS (an HTTP listener that only redirects is a legitimate exception).
policies.rationale: Plain HTTP exposes traffic to interception.

hints: line-level parsing only: no variables, modules or expressions are evaluated

policies.remediation: Terminate TLS and redirect HTTP to HTTPS.

policies.title: IAM policy allows every action
policies.description: Checks that inline IAM policy documents do not allow Action "*".

hints: line-level parsing only: no variables, modules or expressions are evaluated

policies.title: CloudFront allows plain HTTP viewers
policies.description: Checks that viewer_protocol_policy is not allow-all.
policies.rationale: Plain HTTP exposes traffic to interception.

hints: line-level parsing only: no variables, modules or expressions are evaluated
